page.layout: One column of running text, centred on the page. Printed page number "102" at top left. Running head at top centre, with "III." followed by a decorative title in heavy type. A „ mark stands in the left margin beside each line.

main_text.p: illis autē ubi ita dicitur, nō minuit maiestatē, quod egit de Cepione turbulētius: popu-lo enim Ro.dolor iustus uim tū illā excitauit, non Tribuni actio. Maiestas aūt, quoniam est magnitudo quædā popu-li R. in eius potestate ac iure retinendo: aucta est potius quàm diminuta. Et ubi ita re fertur, Maiestas est Imperij atque in omni populi Ro. dignitate, quam minuit is qui per uim multitudinis rē ad sedi-tionē uocauit: existit illa di-sceptatio, Minuerit'ne maie-statē, qui uolūtate populi R. rē gratā & æquā per uim egerit. In his autem caufis, ubi ali quid

page.notes: The „ marks in the left margin are printed quotation marks, one per line, repeated down the page; they are not transcribed as text. Running head: the decorative title is set in heavy type and is not legible enough to copy. The "III." before it is a division number and is left out of the running head. Long s has been normalised to s throughout. The line "rē gratā & æquā" is rendered as printed. Line-end hyphens are kept where printed ("popu-lo", "popu-li", "sedi-tionē", "di-sceptatio" with s normalised to s, "maie-statē"); "dignitate" and "ali quid" are joined without hyphen because no hyphen is printed.
